includes: Parachute system built for two people
gap: Exact duration of tandem jump experience not stated
blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving with experienced instructors after about one hour of instruction. Tandem jumps include approximately 45-60 seconds of freefall and a 4-5 minute canopy ride. The center also offers Instructor Assisted Deployment and Accelerated Freefall training programs for those who want to learn to skydive and earn their license.
